title: Choices.subset drops selected choices inside option groups
author: IlyaKhalafi
body_preview: **Describe the bug**  `Choices.subset()` drops selected choices inside option groups even though their identifiers pass validation. A form using the resulting choices silently loses valid options.  **To reproduce**  ```python from model_utils import Choices  choices = Choices(("State", [(0, "draft", "Draft"), (1, "archived", "Archived")])) selected = choices.subset("archived") print(list(selected)...
